chunks: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abd al-Aziz b. Yahya al-Juludi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Atiyya narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Amr b. Sa'id al-Basri narrated to us. He said: Hisham b. Ja'far narrated to us, from Hammad, from Abdullah b. Sulayman -- and he was a reader of the scriptures -- he said: I read in the Gospel:

O Isa! Be earnest in My command and do not languish. Listen and obey, O son of the pure, chaste virgin. You came into being without a male consort. I created you as a sign for the worlds, so worship Me alone and rely upon Me. Take the scripture with strength, go to the people of Syriac Syria, and convey to those before you that I am God the Eternal who shall never cease. Believe in the Prophet -- may God bless him and his family -- the unlettered one, the owner of the camel, the armour, the crown -- which is the turban -- the two sandals, and the rod -- which is the staff. He has wide eyes, a broad forehead, prominent cheeks, an aquiline nose, and well-spaced front teeth. His neck is like a silver jug, as though gold flows in his collarbones. He has hairs from his chest to his navel, but there is no hair on his stomach or his chest. He is tanned in colour, with a fine line of hair, and large hands and feet. When he turns, he turns with his whole body. When he walks, it is as though he steps firmly from a rock and descends a slope. When he comes among the people, he surpasses them. His sweat on his face is like pearls, and the fragrance of musk emanates from him. None like him was seen before him or after him. He is pleasant in scent, a marrier of women, with few offspring. His offspring is only from a blessed woman who has a house in Paradise, in which there is no clamour or weariness. He will care for her in the end times just as Zakariyya cared for your mother. She has two sons who will be martyred. His speech is the Quran, his religion is Islam, and I am Peace. Blessed is he who lives in his time, witnesses his days, and hears his words. Isa (peace be upon him) said: O Lord, what is Tuba? He said: A tree in Paradise that I planted, which shades the gardens. Its root is from Ridwan, its water is from Tasnim, its coolness is the coolness of camphor, and its taste is the taste of ginger. Whoever drinks from that spring one drink shall never thirst again. Isa (peace be upon him) said: O God, give me to drink from it. He said: It is forbidden, O Isa, for humans to drink from it until that Prophet drinks from it, and it is forbidden for the nations to drink from it until the nation of that Prophet drinks from it. I will raise you to Me, then I will send you down in the end times so that you may see the wonders of that Prophet's nation, and so that you may help them against the accursed Dajjal. I will send you down at the time of prayer so that you may pray with them. Indeed, they are a nation that has been shown mercy.

key_terms.الأمي: The unlettered one (al-Ummi) -- a Quranic descriptor of Prophet Muhammad indicating he received revelation without prior book-learning
key_terms.البتول: Al-Batul -- the chaste/devoted one, a title of the Virgin Mary in the isnad and of Fatima al-Zahra in tradition
key_terms.الدجال: The Dajjal (Antichrist) -- an eschatological deceiver whose appearance is a major sign of the End Times
key_terms.تسنيم: Tasnim -- a spring in the highest Paradise, mentioned in Quran 83:27
key_terms.طوبى: Tuba -- a tree in Paradise, mentioned in Quran 13:29, described here as planted by God with roots in divine pleasure

ai.seo_question: What does the Gospel say about Prophet Muhammad according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq records what Abdullah b. Sulayman found in the Gospel: God's address to Prophet Isa (Jesus) describing the coming Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) in vivid physical detail, his blessed daughter Fatima al-Zahra with her two martyred sons (Hasan and Husayn), the Tuba tree in Paradise, and God's promise to return Isa at the end of times to pray with Muhammad's nation against the Dajjal.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-`Aziz b. Yahya al-Juludi narrated to us. He said: [Muhammad b. `Atiyya narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. `Amr b. Sa`id al-Basri narrated to us. He said:] Hisham b. Ja`far narrated to us from Hammad from `Abdullah b. Sulayman, who used to read the Scripture. He said: I read in the Gospel:

O `Isa! Renew My Order and do not languish. Listen and obey, O son of the pure, chaste virgin. You are not a fool. I made you a sign for the worlds, so worship Me and rely on Me. Take the scripture with strength, go to the people of Syria and Assyria, and inform those before you that I am the eternal God who will never recede, and to believe in the Prophet of the Mother Town, the owner of the camel, the armour, the crown – which is the turban – the two sandals, and the rod – which is the staff. He will have wide eyes, a broad forehead, prominent cheeks, a thin and curved nose, and white teeth. His neck will be like a silver jar, his collarbones will be like gold. He will have hair from his chest to his navel, but not on his stomach or his [entire] chest. He will be tanned in colour, with light hair from his chest to his stomach. His hands and feet will be large. When he turns, he will turn with his whole body. When he walks, it is as though he is stepping from stone to stone (he does not drag his feet). When he walks with the people, he overcomes them [in speed]. The sweat on his face is like pearls, and his scent is like the fragrance of musk. No one like him was ever seen before him nor after him. His scent will be pleasant. He will marry women, but he will have few children, and his child (Fatima) will be blessed, and she will have a house in Paradise. He will support her in the end times just as Zakariyya supported your mother. She will give birth to two martyrs. His words will be the Quran, and his religion will be Islam, and I am Peace. So, Tuba is for he who lives in his time, sees his days, and listens to his words.  So, `Isa (as) said: O Lord! What is Tuba? He said: A tree in Paradise that I planted with My two hands in the shade of Paradise. Its root is in being pleased [with My will], its water is from tasnim, its breeze is from camphor, and its taste is like ginger. Whomever drinks from its river will never thirst again. So, `Isa (as) said: O Allah! Allow me to drink from it. He said: "O `Isa! It is forbidden for the humans to drink from it until that Prophet drinks from it. It is forbidden for the nations to drink from it until the nation of that Prophet drinks from it. O `Isa! I will raise you to Me, then I will send you back down in the End Times so that you may see the marvelous nation of that Prophet, and to save them from the cursed Dajjal. I will send you down during the time of prayer so that you may pray with them. Surely, they are a Nation that has been given mercy.
